title: LARK — SLEEP_DIARY table
description: Array of diary records. One element is one participant-night. Structurally skipped values remain as reserved sentinel codes so the dataset stays rectangular; the routing rules are enforced below.
$comment: Standard JSON Schema cannot enforce uniqueness of participant_id + diary_date across rows (D011). See the README's 'Documented but not enforced' section.

allOf.$comment: Skip pattern: no nap yesterday means nap duration is structurally not applicable.
Applicability: a reported nap must have a duration or an item-missing code — never the structural-NA code.
